description: The pie chart presents the distribution of samples across subtasks in the MMRA benchmark, showing both the count and proportion for each subtask, and it contains 11 slices. The slices are labeled directly with integers and percentages (shown next to or just outside the wedges) and include: ObservationAngle in a mint/teal color at 126 (12.28%); SimilarMaterial in orange at 106 (10.33%); SubEvent in red/pink at 100 (9.74%); UsageSimilarity in a salmon/orange tone at 100 (9.65%); Environment in dark teal at 90 (8.77%); Layout in pale yellow at 90 (8.77%); AppearanceSimilarity in light green at 90 (8.77%); SimilarEvent in light blue at 90 (8.77%); MentalitySimilarity in light cyan at 89 (8.67%); RelativePosition in light gray at 81 (7.90%); and NearSameEntity in dark gray at 63 (6.34%). There is no separate legend, no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized, and the wedges are arranged around the circle without an obvious strictly descending size order.
